newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania nominates OAU chief for re-election.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania nominates OAU chief for re-election.

text.p: Tanzania has nominated the Organisation of African Unity's chief Salim Ahmed Salim for a third term in office, a foreign ministry spokesman said on Friday.
"We think the OAU still needs him. By the look of things Salim has done a good job particularly in conflict management and resolution," said spokesman Cyprian Majengo.
Tanzanian President Benjamin Mkapa this week wrote to African leaders to lobby support for Salim, a Tanzanian Zanzibari whose four-year term as OAU secretary-general expires in June.
Salim, who needs the vote of two-thirds of the OAU's 53 member states, is so far unopposed though diplomats say his re-election is not a foregone conclusion.
